BiblicalUsage: Mamre = "strength" or "fatness"; n pr m; 1) an Amorite who allied himself with Abram; n pr loc; 2) an oak grove on Mamre's land in Palestine where Abraham dwelt; 3) a place near Abraham's burial place, apparently identified with Hebron
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
